plugins.name: Advanced Achievements
plugins.headline: Give player progress a purpose.
plugins.description: Create milestones with claimable rewards, linked prerequisites, and persistent player progress.
optional: Vault and an economy provider for money rewards
plugins.first_copy: Open the achievement browser to inspect progress and claim unlocked rewards.
plugins.notes: Achievements, messages, and rewards are defined in YAML. SQLite is available for a single server; MySQL can support shared tracking. Economy rewards need Vault and an economy provider.

features.title: 30 Predefined Achievements
features.copy: Includes a full starter progression set with combat, utility, exploration, economy, and endgame milestone achievements

features.title: 19 Task Types
features.copy: Tracks block break/place, item pickup/crafting/smelting, mob and player kills, damage dealt/taken, fishing, eating, enchanting, trading, mining, breeding, taming, death, walk distance, and play time with ANY and specific targets

features.title: Reward System
features.copy: Five reward types supported per achievement - items, XP, economy money (via Vault), server commands with {player} and {uuid} placeholders, and title messages - all defined directly in achievements.yml

features.title: Achievement Prerequisites
features.copy: Achievements can require other achievements to be unlocked first, enabling multi-step progression chains

features.title: Hidden Achievements
features.copy: Achievements can be flagged as hidden so they do not appear in the list or GUI until the player has already unlocked them

features.title: Interactive GUI
features.copy: An inventory-based achievement browser with paginated display, real-time progress bars, colour-coded states (locked/unlocked/claimed), and click-to-claim reward functionality

features.title: Chat Creation Wizard
features.copy: Administrators can create new achievements interactively through a guided step-by-step chat flow without editing any YAML manually

features.title: Database Integration
features.copy: Supports both SQLite (single-server) and MySQL (multi-server/network) with fully asynchronous load and save operations

features.title: Broadcast Notifications
features.copy: On unlock, players receive a title and chat notification; an optional server-wide broadcast message is configurable

features.title: Sound and Firework Effects
features.copy: Unlock events trigger a configurable sound and an optional firework display at the player's location

features.title: Progress Bar Display
features.copy: Optional ActionBar or BossBar progress display, configurable refresh interval and display trigger

features.title: Fully Customisable Messages
features.copy: All chat output, prefixes, GUI labels, and notification text are editable in messages.yml

features.title: Developer API
features.copy: A full Java API (AchievementAPI) is exposed for other plugins to create achievements, query progress, grant unlocks, and add progress programmatically

plugins.name: Hookshot
plugins.headline: Find a new way across.
plugins.description: Turn a fishing rod into a grappling hook with per-player range, pull speed, and effects.
plugins.first_copy: Enable grappling mode, hold a fishing rod, and cast toward a block within your configured range.
plugins.notes: Block grappling pulls the player to the hook. Catching a non-player living entity pulls it toward the player. Range, speed, boost, sound, and particles can be adjusted per player.

features.title: Toggle Mode
features.copy: Each player independently enables or disables grappling hook mode - casting while disabled behaves as a normal fishing rod with no side effects

features.title: Block Grappling
features.copy: When the hook lands on a block within range, the player is pulled toward that position immediately with velocity proportional to their configured pull speed and vertical boost

features.title: Entity Grappling
features.copy: When the hook catches a non-player living entity (mob, animal, etc.), the entity is pulled toward the player - useful for mob retrieval and custom gameplay scenarios

features.title: Configurable Hook Velocity
features.copy: Adjustable throw multiplier (1.0-5.0) controls how fast and far the hook travels through the air before landing

features.title: Configurable Pull Speed
features.copy: Adjustable pull speed (0.5-5.0) controls how quickly the player is moved toward the hook landing point

features.title: Vertical Boost
features.copy: Optional upward momentum (0.0-1.5) added to the pull direction, helping players clear ledges and obstacles naturally

features.title: Range Limit
features.copy: Each player has a maximum hook range (10-100 blocks set by the server); pulls beyond that range are cancelled with an informational message

features.title: Pull Cooldown
features.copy: A 250 ms gap is enforced between consecutive pulls to prevent rubber-banding or velocity stacking

features.title: Sound Feedback
features.copy: Optional pull sound (ENTITY_ENDER_DRAGON_FLAP) played at the player's location, toggleable per player

features.title: Particle Trail
features.copy: Optional CLOUD particle burst spawned at the player's location on pull, toggleable per player

features.title: Persistent Settings
features.copy: All per-player data is written to plugins/Hookshot/playerdata.yml on every change and on server shutdown, and reloaded on every player join

features.title: Reset Command
features.copy: Restores all personal settings to the server-configured defaults in a single command
